neighbours.label: the adjective in 'have a good time', 'a good cry', 'a great time', 'an excellent afternoon', a pleasant experience one has, as opposed to good as a plain quality
fire: The neighbors were out dancing and having a good time.

Everyone had a great time at the lake this summer.
We had a lovely evening out with my sister.
After the exam she wanted a good laugh with friends.
They went camping and had a wonderful week away.
Sit down and have a good rest before dinner.

My sister has a lovely cottage near the coast.
